name: IC 4951 (Hubble)
blurb: IC 4951, an edge-on barred spiral galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ic4951-hubble
story: A nearby disk galaxy turned edge-on to us, rich in hydrogen gas. Hubble resolved its brightest stars as part of an effort to picture every known galaxy in our cosmic neighborhood and measure their distances.

claims.text: IC 4951 is classified SBdm (barred late-type spiral) with an optical inclination of 90 degrees (edge-on)
IC 4951 contains a measured reservoir of neutral hydrogen gas
IC 4951 was observed in HST program 15922 'Every Known Nearby Galaxy', which resolves brightest stars in galaxies within about 10 Mpc to measure tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distances
